label: LinkedIn Jobs Scraper
title: LinkedIn Jobs Scraper: Postings, Salary & Recruiter
metaDescription: Scrape LinkedIn job postings in bulk: title, company, date, location, salary min/max, seniority, applicants, full description and the recruiter.
intro: Search LinkedIn jobs in bulk and get title, company, exact posting date, location, salary range parsed to min and max, seniority, employment type, industry, applicant count, full description and the recruiter who posted it.
useCases: Find companies that are hiring for roles you sell to
Track salary ranges for a job title
Build a job board or alert for a niche

faq.q: Is there a LinkedIn jobs API?
faq.a: Only for approved partners that post jobs. This actor searches public LinkedIn jobs by keyword and location (or a search link) and returns each job with company, salary range, applicants and the full description.

faq.q: Does it need a LinkedIn login?
faq.a: No. It reads the public job pages LinkedIn shows to logged-out visitors.

faq.q: Can I use it as a LinkedIn jobs API?
faq.a: Yes. Start a run from your own code with Apify's REST API (or the JavaScript and Python clients) and read the results as JSON; the run-sync endpoint returns the items in the same HTTP call. The same input also runs in the Apify Console, on a schedule, or from Make, Zapier and n8n.

officialApi: LinkedIn's job APIs are only for approved job-posting partners; there is no public job search API. This actor reads the public LinkedIn job listings anyone can see without logging in.
